assets.role: Conceptual README hero illustration; not a product screenshot.
assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: polished wide GitHub README hero illustration for RemoteAssist, a Windows remote support tool for internal PC operations.
Primary request: create one exceptional editorial tech product banner, landscape about 2.2:1. Deep midnight navy background, elegant teal/cyan highlights based on existing brand color #0c8497, subtle fine grid, restrained soft glow, crisp premium 3D isometric computers with beautiful studio light, generous spacing and excellent hierarchy. No people.
Composition: on the left third clean large typography with EXACT main title "RemoteAssist" and small subtitle "Windows Remote Support". Below place three beautifully typeset feature pills with EXACT text "One launch", "9-digit ID", "Browser viewer". Across the right two thirds show a Windows desktop computer and a laptop browser connected by a luminous direct teal link, with identical stylized remote desktop windows to imply screen sharing. Around this central connection, include small carefully crafted visual symbols for mouse cursor, file transfer, terminal command window, and admin shield. Use a subtle connection-status dot and a visible stop-square control on the target device to imply visible support status and ability to end support.
The image is conceptual product artwork, not a screenshot. Keep interfaces abstract and do not invent performance statistics or realistic UI text. No cloud relay, no padlocks or password/PIN login, no remote unattended forever narrative, no third-party logos, no watermark, no spelling variations. Typography must be rendered exactly as supplied and remain legible when scaled to 900px width. Fill the full landscape canvas, no external white border. Sophisticated and calm, not a busy sci-fi gaming poster.

assets.role: README architecture overview based on docs/README.md#architecture.
assets.prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram.
Asset type: accurate wide technical architecture illustration for RemoteAssist GitHub README, landscape approx 1.8:1, high resolution.
Create an exceptionally clean, professionally typeset architecture infographic. Use deep midnight navy background, elegant teal/cyan highlights matching #0c8497, white text, flat rounded cards, very subtle grid, restrained line icons. Readability at 1000 pixels wide is essential. This is a technical diagram, not a screenshot. No 3D perspective.
Exact large heading at upper left: "Direct P2P. Full remote support."
Layout: TWO large clearly bounded side-by-side computer groups. Left group titled "TARGET PC" and right group titled "SUPPORT PC". All boxes must be entirely within their owning computer boundary.
Left group: upper small card "Host.Service", subtitle "SYSTEM / Session 0", one descriptive line "Support ID / Worker supervision". Below it a distinct large sub-container titled "USER SESSION", containing exactly four cards, neatly laid out: "Tray" with "Status / Stop support"; "Helper" with "H.264 / WebRTC"; "AdminHelper" with "SYSTEM / UAC / Input"; "RunbookWorker" with "PowerShell / Runbooks". Add a thin local supervision line from Host.Service down to USER SESSION without crossing any text. Draw one small local arrow from AdminHelper to Helper, labeled "Frames", representing shared frames.
Right group: upper card "Tunnel server" with subtitle "Go / HTTPS + WSS" and line "Viewer page / Support ID / SDP + ICE". Below it a separate card "Web Viewer" with subtitle "Browser / No install".
Across the gap between left and right group draw EXACTLY TWO external bidirectional connections, with clear endpoints:
(1) a thin dashed blue connection from left Helper to right Tunnel server, labeled "HTTPS / WSS". This is setup traffic only.
(2) a prominent solid teal connection from left Helper to right Web Viewer, labeled "Direct WebRTC P2P". Under that connection, readable small text "Screen / Input / Files / Data".
Draw a small thin local line between Tunnel server and Web Viewer inside the right group labeled "HTTPS / WSS".
At bottom place an elegant legend: dashed blue swatch "Connection setup" and solid teal swatch "Media + data". In a separate footer sentence: "Media and data stay on the direct PC-to-PC link."
Constraints: keep edges out of cards and text. The media/data line must never enter the tunnel server. No cloud icon, relay node, STUN or TURN node. No unsupported FPS or latency claims. Never place AdminHelper in Session 0: it belongs inside USER SESSION. Spell all exact supplied labels correctly. No additional cards, no added topology, no watermark. Favor spacious information hierarchy and generous margins.
edits: Edit this architecture image with ONE targeted correction. Preserve the entire image, all typography, colors, geometry, layout, headings, connections, labels, and exact canvas size. Swap the CONTENTS of the two bottom cards inside USER SESSION: the bottom LEFT card must now be "RunbookWorker" with terminal icon and subtitle "PowerShell / Runbooks"; the bottom RIGHT card directly beneath "Helper" must now be "AdminHelper" with shield icon and subtitle "SYSTEM / UAC / Input". The existing upward "Frames" arrow must connect from this bottom RIGHT AdminHelper card into Helper above it. Do not move the arrow, do not change any other cards or external connections, and do not change anything else. This ensures that AdminHelper, not RunbookWorker, supplies screen frames to Helper.

assets.role: Illustrated Korean usage guide: initial administrator launch, share support ID, browser connection, remote assistance, and target-initiated stop.
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: Korean illustrated step-by-step usage guide at the bottom of the GitHub README for RemoteAssist, a Windows remote support tool.
Primary request: explain concretely how an office employee receives remote help from an internal PC support operator, through one beautiful complete illustrated workflow. Create a high-resolution portrait infographic, approximately 1400x1800, five clearly numbered horizontal scene panels stacked vertically. This must communicate usage immediately to a Korean reader. Large legible Korean sans-serif typography, excellent spelling, calm premium editorial tech illustrations, midnight navy with teal/cyan #0c8497, white text, generous spacing, thin glowing connections. Beautiful isometric PCs and friendly understated office-worker/support-operator figures. Keep the SAME employee with a desktop PC and SAME support operator with a laptop browser throughout. The artwork is a conceptual usage illustration, not a screenshot.

Header exact title: "RemoteAssist 사용 예시"
Header exact subtitle: "한 번 실행하고, ID로 연결해 해결한다"

Each of the five rows must include its number, a compact role badge, a large action title, a single short caption, and an immediately understandable illustrated scene. Thin downward arrows between rows indicate chronology. Make the illustrations substantial, not just tiny icons. Do not mix up the two roles.

ROW 01:
Role badge "대상자"
Action title "프로그램 실행"
Caption "관리자 권한으로 한 번 실행한다"
Scene: office employee at a Windows desktop, a cursor choosing the visible context-menu item "관리자 권한으로 실행" for RemoteAssist. Show the app starting on the employee's PC. This is the only initial administrator launch.

ROW 02:
Role badge "대상자 → 지원자"
Action title "지원 ID 전달"
Caption "표시된 9자리 ID를 지원자에게 알려준다"
Scene: employee's RemoteAssist window displays the exact ID "418-207-935". A clean communication bubble carries the SAME "418-207-935" toward the support operator. Small readable label near ID "예시 ID". Do not show a password or PIN.

ROW 03:
Role badge "지원자"
Action title "브라우저에서 접속"
Caption "지원 ID를 입력하고 접속한다"
Scene: support operator's laptop with a browser window titled "RemoteAssist", input label "지원 ID", field filled with exactly "418-207-935", second input label "지원자 이름" filled with "PC 관리 담당", and a prominent teal button "접속". Cursor points to the connect button. No Viewer software installation, no employee approval dialog.

ROW 04:
Role badge "지원자"
Action title "화면을 보며 문제 해결"
Caption "화면 제어 · 관리자 작업 · 파일 전송 · 진단"
Scene: connected desktop and browser sharing the same simplified Windows application window, pointer moving a window on target screen, small admin shield and file-transfer/terminal tools at the operator's side. On the employee's target PC show a readable visible badge "지원 중". The employee waits comfortably; no further user action required.

ROW 05:
Role badge "대상자"
Action title "필요하면 즉시 종료"
Caption "Tray의 즉시 종료로 지원 허가도 끝낸다"
Scene: close-up of target employee's tray support panel with a clear coral-red button "즉시 종료", hand cursor pressing it, and the link to the support operator visibly disconnecting. End with a subtle completed checkmark. This explicitly means the target employee ends support, rather than the supporter merely leaving the session.

Constraints: Render supplied Korean copy verbatim, do not invent other labels, tiny unreadable paragraphs, product features, performance numbers, passwords, PINs, cloud relays or approval prompts. Never depict persistent authorization after user stop or Windows reboot. Do not replace actual illustrated scenes with architecture/process boxes. No watermark. High readability when scaled to 900px wide. All five scenes and all captions must fit with generous safe margins.
